_comment: Example of the single configuration file this plugin owns. Copy it to
<REA home>/config/rea.env.json and adjust the absolute paths, or simply edit
the values in Settings -> REA, which writes this same file back (with a .bak).
Consumers: the plugin host half, the plugin's MCP bridge (which injects these
variables into the REA child process), the CLI wrappers in scripts/, and the
Advertisement policy for bridge/index.mjs. Harness re-sends every advertised
schema on every request, so directTools stays small; every other REA tool is

engineNotes.node: REA 6.8.0 needs 22.x >= 22.23.4, 24.x >= 24.22.1 or 26.12.1+; pin a copy here instead of touching the machine-wide Node.
engineNotes.ghidra: Windows-native provider, P0 boundary. 12.1.4 is the supported release.
engineNotes.jdk: Full JDK 21+ (Temurin 25 used here); Ghidra headless, jadx and apktool all use it.
engineNotes.jadx: jadx-headless-mcp 0.7.1 jar, supplied by the caller (REA never downloads it).
engineNotes.ilspycmd: REA spawns this without a shell, so point it at the native ilspycmd.exe inside the NuGet tool store, not the .cmd shim.

unavailable.jeb: Commercial JEB; start its MCP client and set REA_JEB_MCP_URL.
unavailable.kuna: Provider has no Windows host support.
